    Methods in com.hkust.marketplace.services with parameters of type Offer
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    DealRules.accept(Offer offer)
    The seller accepts a pending offer, borrow request or claim (Manage Offers & Requests 3.3.3-3.3.6; UC7 Special Requirement 5): the offer is Accepted, the listing becomes Reserved (sale, giveaway) or Lent (lend), every other open offer on the listing is declined, and each affected buyer is notified.
    List<OfferAction>
    Conversation.actionsFor(Offer offer)
    What the viewer can do with one of this chat's offers now; see OfferAction.allowedFor(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Offer, boolean).
    static List<OfferAction>
    OfferAction.allowedFor(Offer offer, boolean viewerIsBuyer)
    The actions the viewer can take on the offer now, in the order of the screens' buttons.
    void
    DealRules.complete(Offer deal)
    The buyer marks an accepted price offer or claim complete (UC7 steps 6-8): the deal gets today's completion date, the listing becomes Sold or Given (or stays Removed), and the seller is notified.
